profile.headline:
Creative Technologist 
Full Stack Developer & Artist 
-Bridging the gap between Art and Tech
profile.summary:
Technical Expertise: Proficient in Python, Java, HTML, and AI. Possess a strong foundation for IT with ongoing pursuit of Net+, Security+, Cloud+ certifications.

Beyond Tech: Creative, personable, and adaptable with a passion for music, culinary arts, design, and video editing.

Project Highlights: Built a bug tracker and chatbot to showcase technical capabilities.

positions.title: AI Software Developer
positions.description:
Combining knowledge of computer science, software engineering, and machine learning I can implement Artificial Intelligence Systems to solve problems.

*I have developed computational tools and algorithms for exploring Calculus and Algebra. 
*Implemented the Finite difference method which approximates derivatives using function values at nearby points.
*Utilized Python and SageMath to develop research prototypes.
*LATEX style formatting
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · LaTeX · Machine Learning · Mathematics · Statistics · Problem Solving · Python (Programming Language) · Data Analysis

positions.title: Chief Executive Officer
positions.description: Nugenesis, LLC is developing cutting-edge AI-powered health monitoring solutions for early disease detection and personalized preventative care. We are pioneering the future of proactive healthcare through advancements in wearable technology, sensor integration, and digital twinning.

positions.title: Graphic Designer
positions.description:
Using my creativity and technical skills to translate ideas into engaging visuals. I am the artist behind the logos, brochures, websites, and other visual elements that shape how the audience perceives information.

Using design software like Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator, I create high-quality graphics, illustrations, and layouts. This may involve typography, color selection, imagery, and other visual elements.

positions.title: Web Designer
positions.description:
*Front-End Development: I bring websites to life by writing code that dictates what users see and interact with on a webpage. I utilize HTML, CSS, and Javascript.

*Back-End Development: I utilize Python to maintain the website's performance.

*Maintenance: Keeping websites up-to-date and resolving technical issues is an ongoing task for web developers.

*Responsiveness: In today's mobile-first world, ensuring websites render well on all devices (desktops, tablets, phones) is crucial.

positions.title: Videographer
positions.description:
Transforms raw video footage into polished and engaging video productions. The storyteller behind the scenes, using editing skills to craft a narrative that informs, entertains, or persuades the audience
Importing and organizing raw footage
Editing video clips to create a cohesive sequence
Adding transitions, titles, sound effects, and music
Applying color correction and other visual effects
Working with graphics and animations (depending on the project)
Ensuring the final video meets the project's specifications and deadlines
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · File Management · Oral Communication · Video Color Grading · Video Editing · Problem Solving · Codecs · Storytelling · Software profiency · Visual Design

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description:
*Experienced math and science tutor providing individualized instruction to students of all ages and academic levels. Specialized in algebra, geometry, calculus, chemistry, and physics.

*Developed effective teaching strategies to enhance student comprehension and problem-solving skills.

*Successfully balanced tutoring responsibilities with a demanding college course load, demonstrating strong time management and organizational skills.

Passionate about education and committed to helping students reach their academic potential.
positions.insights: Skills: Chemistry · Oral Communication · Microsoft Office · Algebra · Physics · Calculus · Assessment

positions.title: Martial Arts Instructor
positions.description:
Third Degree Black Belt: Proven mastery of Taekwondo techniques, forms, sparring, and breaking. Extensive knowledge of ATA curriculum and philosophy.
Dedicated Instructor: Successfully taught countless students of all ages and skill levels, fostering physical fitness, discipline, and character development. Implemented effective teaching methodologies to optimize student progress.
Certified Judge: Possessing three chevron judge certification, demonstrated expertise in evaluating competitive Taekwondo matches at local, regional, and national levels. Ensured fair and accurate scoring while upholding ATA competition standards.
Leadership Development: Served as a mentor and role model to junior instructors, promoting professional growth and leadership within the ATA community.
Community Outreach: Actively participated in community events and demonstrations to increase awareness of Taekwondo and its benefits.
positions.insights: Skills: Oral Communication · Leadership · Technical Expertise · Patience

positions.title: Model
positions.description:
Experienced child model with a passion for performing.
*Featured in commercials for Disney, Twizzlers, and Igloo.
*Walked the runway for charity event
*Participated in Disney projects, showcasing acting and modeling skills.
*Confident and outgoing with a natural ability to connect with audiences.
*Eager to learn and grow as a performer.

volunteerExperiences.description: Participated in cultural celebrations and events. Developed a sense of global awareness and appreciation.

organizations.name: karate America
organizations.description: Conduct classes, teach leadership skills, self defense and various weapons training. Serve as a judge for local, regional, and world tournament competitions. Maintain student records. Greet parents and students
